scenarios.name: postcombat-main-adds-red-per-life-lost
scenarios.why: ... the opponent has lost 3 (a stand-in life loss) plus 4 from Neheb's unblocked combat damage = 7 life lost, so seven red mana is added.

scenarios.name: no-life-lost-no-mana
scenarios.why: With no stand-in life loss but Neheb connecting for 4, the opponent has lost 4 life this turn, so the postcombat main adds four red mana.

scenarios.name: postcombat-main-adds-red-per-life-opponents-lost
scenarios.why: At the beginning of each of Neheb's controller's postcombat main phases, add {R} for each 1 life the opponents have lost this turn. An opponent who lost 3 life this turn yields {R}{R}{R}.

scenarios.name: no-life-lost-adds-nothing
scenarios.why: With no life lost by an opponent this turn, the postcombat main trigger adds no mana.
